page: Hetzner Cloud cpx52 is an x86_64 virtual server powered by the QEMU hypervisor. It features 12 shared AMD EPYC vCPUs running at 2.0 GHz, with 12 physical cores and 1 thread per core. The processor includes 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 23.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 1.95 GB of RAM per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 480 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark testing, the cpx52 demonstrates strong single-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 3041.68 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1947.0, both placing in the top 25%. Multi-core performance is average, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 36626.57 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 10098.0. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient for large blocks, achieving a strong 220.5 GB/sec read-only and 143.81 GB/sec write speed. For lightweight machine learning workloads, the server shows strong performance in LLM text generation, processing 304.2 tokens/sec on a small 135M model and 33.91 tokens/sec on a medium 7B model.

The shared CPU allocation presents a resource-density tradeoff, making the instance highly cost-efficient for workloads that do not require dedicated, sustained CPU performance. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio aligns with compute-optimized profiles, while the integrated 480 GB NVMe SSD provides fast local storage without additional provisioning. This server is well-suited for web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate text or image processing tasks.
